answer: In PoA, EigenTrust scores propagate through the interaction matrix and reciprocity-weighted transitivity, then undergo exponential temporal decay, making reputation require sustained honest service rather than a brief burst. A freshly spawned Sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality, little trusted incoming mass, and cannot cross consensus thresholds; even an umber beacon in a nebula of colluding identities cannot bootstrap influence without persistent reciprocal validation.
